FreeType typing statistics uses portions of WowType

Source: https://github.com/Gloridust/WowType
Revision: bb2a04fd573f1e5f2444ee68f8f71b7ea429b3c5
File: settings/wowtype-config
Original project: WowType, Gloridust and contributors

The upstream README declares the code available under MIT OR Apache-2.0.
FreeType chooses Apache-2.0. The complete license and the original README
are included beside this notice. Dictionary and model licenses are separate.

FreeType adapted stats_rows, stats_heat_level, stats_metrics,
stats_scope_counts, stats_recent_days, stats_format_active, and the
overview, keyboard, trend, character-kind and candidate-rank pages to Go/mygo.
Changes include Windows Set-1 scan codes and the existing daily data format,
standard mygo charts instead of GTK/Cairo, the FreeType palette, text scaling,
horizontal scrolling, calendar-day arithmetic, and retained Windows views.
Mode and scheme breakdowns are not shown because those counters are not collected.
Unmodified source excerpts are included in source/.
